items.summary: Replace the portfolio headshot static assets under "frontend/public/assets/generated" with square-cropped PNGs derived from the newly uploaded image file "Profile picture (2)-4.png", overwriting the existing files using the exact filenames: (1) "portfolio-headshot.dim_512x512.png" (512x512) and (2) "portfolio-headshot-large.dim_1280x1280.png" (1280x1280).

Force a browser cache refresh for the headshot by incrementing the "HEADSHOT_VERSION" value in "frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts" so that the HEADSHOT_512 and HEADSHOT_1280 URLs change (query-string cache bust), while keeping the headshot filenames unchanged.

Verify that every place the portfolio UI displays the headshot uses the centralized constants from "frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts" (HEADSHOT_512 and HEADSHOT_1280) rather than any hard-coded headshot image paths, so all headshot renders benefit from cache-busting.
